controls.title: Git
controls.command: while true; do clear; git -c color.ui=always status -sb 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a git repo'; echo; git -c color.ui=always log --oneline -8 2>/dev/null; sleep 5; done

controls.title: Ports
controls.command: while true; do clear; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P -n 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || /LISTEN/' | head -20; sleep 10; done

controls.title: System
controls.command: command -v htop >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec htop || exec top -o cpu
